plugins.name: azure-finops
plugins.description: Read-only Azure FinOps with one consolidated, daily-refreshed dashboard. Setup requires a Managed resources or Everything scope choice and grants missing read-only cost roles on your behalf (OBO). Includes managed-resource anomaly alerts and explicit coverage gaps for optional reporting inputs. Budget changes remain human-reviewed scripts.
